ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Bilateral symmetry in pigmentation; large, high-intensity white blobs located on the peripheral distal regions of both lobes, transitioning into solid low-intensity black pixels towards the central median notch and proximal peduncle area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression; approximate angle of 140 degrees with a depth of approximately 5% of total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the full trailing edge; irregular amplitude variations between 2 and 6 pixels; distinct jagged profile more pronounced on the inner-half of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the median notch extending to the distal tips; distal tips exhibit an acute, upward-curving taper.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small black 'island' marking isolated within the high-intensity white patch of the right-side distal tip.
